steps.title: Inspect image 1
steps.description: The model receives two images (image 1 shown here) and an instruction to inspect the upper-left quarter of image 1.

steps.title: A real crop call
steps.description: MosaicAgent selects crop with x1=0, y1=0, x2=0.5, y2=0.5. The workspace returns a new image without changing the original.

steps.title: Inspect, then answer
steps.description: The next model request contains all three images. MosaicAgent finishes with the answer: rotated.

source: A recorded checkpoint validation run. The crop instruction is explicit; this is not an unprompted benchmark success or an accuracy claim.
